environment.description: Production deployment on bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Service runs on port 8080 with TLS terminated at the NLB. No additional middleware or reverse proxy. Session cookies are set with SameSite=None for cross-subdomain SSO compatibility. CORS is not enforced at any layer. The secret rotation runs every 60 seconds but issued tokens persist in the token map indefinitely (no TTL eviction).

config.token_ttl: unlimited (tokens persist in map after rotation)
